one_liner: Firecrawl has a hosted REST API (v2) with free self-serve API keys, OAuth 2.1 for apps, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer API keys (fc-...) are the main documented method. OAuth 2.1 'OAuth for apps' lets users connect their own Firecrawl account (fco_ access tokens, fcr_ refresh tokens). Details such as PKCE and dynamic registration come from the earlier draft and aren't re-verified in the supplied pages.
access_notes: Free plan needs no card and gives 1,000 credits a month. Scrape, search and parse also work keyless, with limits.
blocker_notes: None. Free credits are limited but enough to build and test.
